text: Every reply sent under the game root whose text has exactly one line matching the Answers: pattern and exactly one line matching the Asks: pattern shall carry "turn": true in sent.jsonl, however it was sent; a reply classed as a game turn post shall also carry "game_turn": true.
acceptance: An exempt turn gets turn and game_turn true; a turn-shaped reply sent under the cap gets turn true and no game_turn; an ordinary reply without the lines gets neither.
rationale: Replaces Morphyx's GAMECAP-MARK: the chain and ceiling must see turns that fell back to the cap, or one fallback breaks every later turn.

text: A reply shall be classed as a game turn post only if its Answers: line equals the Asks: line of the most recent sent.jsonl entry with turn true, the check being skipped when no such entry exists.
acceptance: Sequence: A exempt with 'Asks: x'; B sent under the cap with 'Answers: x', 'Asks: y' (fails 24h); C with 'Answers: y' passes chain; C with 'Answers: x' fails with 'chain'.
rationale: Replaces Morphyx's GAMECAP-CHAIN, which read the last game_turn entry and so cascaded after a single fallback.

text: The send code shall hold a game turn post if the most recent sent.jsonl entry with turn true has an 'at' less than 10800 seconds before send time.
acceptance: In the sequence above, C at B + 10799 s is held in held.json with reason 'ceiling'; at B + 10800 s it sends.
rationale: Replaces Modulo's GAMECAP-CEIL so a turn sent under the cap still counts toward the thread ceiling.
